items.information: # This competition has been moved to Long Beach! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors are **expected** to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). This competition **WILL NOT** have most sighted events, such as 3x3x3 Cube. We recommend first-time competitors not register for this competition. For a more traditional competition experience, please check the [West Coast Cubing website](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) for a competition near you. **Current USC students can compete for free!** Please indicate so in the comment field during registration and send a photo of your student ID to the organization team to waive the registration fee. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized by CubeSC, USC's Rubik's Cube Club, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

items.information: WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SuwonSummer2025#60130-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SuwonSummer2025#60129-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SuwonSummer2025#60130-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SuwonSummer2025#60129-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.
